Party Like a BOSS!
Monsters have scared away everyone! Explore Terra da Festa and report back to me with your findings. Oh, and bring me a Mapinguiari Foot… for luck!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Great! Well… not great, since there are monsters everywhere! I made a list of all the monsters in the area. This will help you with your next quest.

Now that you have seen all the monsters, it is time to beat them up! Defeat two monsters of every type and come back to me when the job is done.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Nice work! Oh… what is this? A Ravaged Feather? We will need more of these to adorn the fantastic feather costumes for Carnaval!

These monsters really want to ruin Carnaval, don't they? We will show them! Beat up the baddies until you find 10 more Carnaval Headdresses. The Terra da Festa dancers need Headdresses to dance down the Sambódromo!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
These headdresses are perfect for the dancers. But there are still too many monsters. What we need to do now is make a Carranca to ward off the evil spirits.

Carrancas are wooden sculptures used to ward off evil spirits. So let's make one to scare away all the monsters before Carnaval begins! We will need 5 Pieces of Wood from the Terra Trees, 2 Fangs from the Boiúna, Cuco's Claw for carving, Mulher de Branco's Hair, and a Horse Tail Paint Brush from Mula Sem Cabeça. Good luck!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Look at that! You have made a Carranca! All the monsters should be scared away by now. But there’s still one more monster out to ruin Carnaval… and you will find him under the Sambódromo arch!

Carnaval is about to begin! Take the Carranca to the Sambódromo Arch and defeat the beast who is the ultimate party crasher! If you can defeat him, then Carnaval can begin. Best of luck! Battle on, hero!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You did it! Carnaval is saved! Festa on!

Quests Begun From:

Saci Do What he Wants
Undying Rage
Can Ya Smell What Cuca's Cooking?
Regardless if you believe in fairy tales or not, the local stories and folklore here, well.. They're all here. You'll see Saci holding a spoon right now. I think that spoon belongs to a woman named Nastácia. He probably has her other cookware on him. It's best we get it back. Knowing our luck, he probably doesn't even have all of them on him.. We'll have to trap him. You remember how to do that, right?
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Somehow, as amazed I am, I don't think that's the last we'll see of him.
Items Required:
Trapped Saci x1
Dropped by
Saci
Rewards:
500 Gold
500 Exp
Items:
Poeira do Saci
x3
Hey Hero, so there's this ghoul in the forest and… it might sound crazy but… it might very well be Corpo-Seco. I know we were just talking about him in folklore but I did say there's been sightings in the forest, no? Would you uhh, go take care of that? Bring me something as proof so I know it's been dealt with.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Regardless if this was indeed Corpo-Seco or not, I can't help but feel bad for him.
Items Required:
Corpo-Seco's Nails x5
Dropped by
Corpo-Seco (Monster)
Rewards:
850 Gold
850 Exp
Items:
Ossos do Corpo-Seco
x2
So friend, I can call you friend now after everything yes? A few locals told me children have wandered into the forest and they haven't returned yet. I hate to think the stories are real BUT on the slight chance they are.. Can we go look inside and see if we can find them? I don't have a very good feeling about this.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
To think she was actually existing this entire time.. The stories…
Items Required:
Cuca's Hat x1
Dropped by
Cuca
Rewards:
1,500 Gold
1,500 Exp
Items:
Escamas da Cuca
x1

Elemental Balance
Bandits and Treasure Hunters
Plants be Spooky
The Test of Will
Most elementals will keep to themselves. There are some though, that are very aggressive and will attack anything or anyone on sight. They will sometimes uproot rare plants when attacking. Take a walk through the Amazon if you like and see if any elementals attack you. I'm sure you'll be fine.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
So you did manage to get some? Thank you, friend. I know it's a strange request but there are many elementals who stay hidden and protect the Amazon.
Items Required:
Anger of The Elements x6
Dropped by
Earth Elemental (2) (Level 30)
Dropped by
Water Elemental (1) (Level 30)
Rewards:
900 Gold
1,300 Exp

Keeper of the Amazon
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
The Amazon is vast and beautiful but that also brings trouble. Bandits come to hide out in the dense vegetation. Most are just looking to make an easy fortune. They uproot everything in their path to find something of value, leaving destruction in their path. If you find anyone out there damaging the land, be sure to teach them that the Amazon is beautiful but also dangerous. Scare them out.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Thank you once again, friend, for your efforts.
